chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
Máhte, Branán, Aodhín, Leofwine, Máret, Hallhild Bjarnardóttir, Kaunikki, Minvydas, Beornred and Máret arrived together in summer.

The founding party had two adult cows and one adult bull and 1 longship.

Máhte and Beornred worked as farmers. Branán, Hallhild Bjarnardóttir and Minvydas worked as hunters. Aodhín, Leofwine, Máret and Máret worked as fishers. Kaunikki worked as a woodworker.

Hallhild Bjarnardóttir and Beornred were already partners. Kaunikki and Minvydas were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.
